americas_summary: The Americas face direct fuel-price, freight, trade, and supply-chain exposure, alongside localized flood impacts in Colorado and regional security spillover from Haiti. Evidence does not establish an Americas-wide infrastructure, banking, food, or health access failure.
confidence_rationale: Fresh, multi-source reporting supports energy, shipping, trade, flooding, and Haiti assessments; several high-severity maritime claims remain unconfirmed, and some cyber/payment evidence is indirect or non-Americas-specific. Evidence gate: 13 items, 11 sources, 5 Tier-A sources, 5/5 clusters.
summary: Severe energy and shipping stress remains the main civilian-disruption risk, moderated by continued protected tanker transits and bypass capacity. Colorado flooding is an active U.S. disruption; no verified systemic financial or payments outage is evidenced.
primary_driver: Middle East maritime insecurity driving oil-price and shipping-cost pressure amid partial Hormuz mitigation.
primary_stabilizers: Some tanker operators continued night transits through a U.S.-protected lane, while Saudi Arabia tripled oil flows through a pipeline bypassing Hormuz.
The United States identified imported wind-turbine components as a security concern but directed negotiations rather than imposing new tariffs immediately.
China’s expanded rare-earth and critical-mineral export controls remain suspended through November 10, 2026, providing temporary supply-chain relief.
The IMF says global financial markets and banks remain broadly resilient, despite elevated cyber, sovereign-yield, leverage, and liquidity risks.
USGS reported California volcanoes at normal background levels, while Kīlauea activity remained confined largely within a closed park area.

preparedness_actions: Complete sensible, previously planned preparedness purchases while normal supply channels are functioning.
Maintain several weeks of food, household consumables, water capacity, and essential medical supplies.
Keep vehicles reasonably fueled and verify generator, battery, solar, or other backup-power capability.
Maintain diversified payment options and a reasonable amount of emergency cash.
Confirm family communications, transportation, and meeting plans.
Avoid panic buying; focus on resilience gaps that would be difficult to correct after disruption begins.

methodology.note: All-hazards early-warning assessment. The score is a preparedness-urgency index, not the probability that a disaster, collapse, or war will occur.
methodology.formula: Preparedness Urgency = 40% Global Threat Pressure + 25% Observed Civilian Disruption + 10% Cross-System Coupling + 10% Momentum/Persistence + 15% Americas Exposure. Global threat, observed impact, and Americas exposure are weighted averages across all 12 domains.
methodology.rate_limits: Absent a verified hard trigger, normal daily movement is limited to ±3 points. A verified but non-severe hard trigger allows up to ±6. A verified national, multinational, or global hard trigger can bypass the rate limit.
methodology.stage_guardrails: HIGH ALERT begins at 80. IMMINENT DISRUPTION requires a score of at least 90, observed disruption of at least 75, and a verified severe hard trigger plus either 48-hour persistence or an active fast-onset trigger. ACTIVE DISRUPTION requires at least 97, observed disruption at least 85, three high-impact domains, and two verified severe triggers.
methodology.civil_unrest: Civil Unrest / Public Order is scored from observable violence, duration, geographic spread, emergency measures, infrastructure damage, and disruption to transport, commerce, public safety, or essential services. Peaceful protest and political ideology do not raise the score by themselves.
methodology.confidence: Evidence confidence is capped mechanically by source quality, recency, independence, cluster coverage, and actual web-search completion. It does not increase preparedness urgency.
methodology.pipeline: GPT-5.6 Luna collects current evidence in paced, low-context, one-search cluster requests to stay below TPM limits. GPT-5.6 Terra evaluates only validated evidence with no web access. JavaScript validates hard triggers and calculates the final score mechanically.
